verdict.rationale: Unleash documents official SDKs for both server and client sides: 15 official client and server SDKs, backend SDKs authenticated with backend tokens, and client-safe frontend tokens. Community evidence confirms official backend clients for Java, Node.js, Go, Ruby and Python. Mobile SDKs and consistent flag-evaluation behavior across SDKs are not documented in the evidence. missing for 10: explicit official mobile SDK evidence, documentation of consistent flag behavior across SDKs, independent hands-on corroboration of cross-stack use.

support.subject: As a developer, I can use official SDKs across my whole stack — backend, web, and mobile — with consistent flag behavior

citations.quote: It supports 15 official client and server SDKs and over 15 community SDKs.
With over 30 SDKs, we enable fast and secure feature flagging across all major programming languages.
use one of the client or backend SDKs to connect Unleash with your application
Backend tokens for connecting backend SDKs or Unleash Edge to Unleash.
Frontend tokens are not considered secret and are safe to expose client-side.
